liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Jerry starts laying fills and alternating riffs, while Phil goes hyperactive [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-10-16.131539.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 252 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1974-10-16.sbd.patched.eaton-miller.90145.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 249 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience noise is drowned out by the loud music, making the recording good [21]
- **gd1974-10-16.176619.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 25 songs; 235 min [5]
- **gd1974-10-16.fob.sonyecm250.falenga.motb-0131.107036.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 234 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer's audible singing is captured in the first three or four tracks [11]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood near Louis Falenga, who gestured for silence during the first few songs [11]
- Reviewer attended four of the five nights, noting all venues were packed [14]
- Ned Lagin plays electric piano and synthesizer for the Seastones performance [5]
- Reviewer prefers the soundboard over this audience recording, despite the latter's tolerable quality [14]
- The album's Ship of Fools is from this night, not October 18, due to electric piano [19]
- This concert has the best Second Set of the five-day run, despite being the odd one out [20]
- Reviewer prefers the audience recording because Bob's guitar is inaudible on the soundboard [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-10-16.131539.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:90145) Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus ->… [1]
- **gd1974-10-16.sbd.patched.eaton-miller.90145.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: Lineage confirmed accurate; patches from AUD, multitrack, and master reel sources included [2]
- **gd1974-10-16.176619.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Louis Falanga's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM 250 mic > Sony TC-110 (Maxell UD C120) [5]
- **gd1974-10-16.fob.sonyecm250.falenga.motb-0131.107036.flac16**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke and David Minches and Derek McCabe; source: Sony ECM 250 >> Sony 110 (mono) >> MAC [7]
